title: Audio Showcase
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/work -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html exists
checks.browser: Chromium via playwright-core, real production output at required subpath
checks.interactions: passed: navigation, collection dialogs, cart, mobile menu, previous/next, heart state, Escape dismissal
checks.boomerang: passed: decoded 1920x1080 source; 960x540 captured frames; video hidden and canvas shown after first pass
checks.entrance_animation: backwards fill; transform released after animation
checks.font: supplied Helvetica face loaded locally; required remote stylesheet retained

asset_issues: Chromium reported net::ERR_ABORTED for superseded video startup/preload requests. Source decoding and completed boomerang playback passed on desktop and mobile.

Duplicate Helvetica declarations make document.fonts.check return false because the remote declaration remains unloaded. The bundled supplied WOFF2 face is loaded and used. No font network or console errors were observed.
notes: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, lucide-react; base /motionsites-results/audio-showcase/.

Static hero. Track metadata and likes are local demonstration state; no audio source, backend, checkout, or persistence.
